headline: The symmetric two-per-bank six-variable Householder target witness has an exact elementary cone-tip small-ball derivative I*=4.0630706168060372601...>4.063; the previous quadrature is eliminated. Every physical principal triple is singular or only half-scale. The strongest unrestricted lower obstruction remains 3sqrt(2).
partner_application: For A_p=[[1,1,-1],[1,0,1],[-1,1,0]] with spectrum {1,sqrt(3),-sqrt(3)}, account02/B17's zero-pivot theorem gives ||p_{X^2+2XY-2XZ+2YZ}||_infty <= 2+log(5/3)=2.51082562376599... for arbitrary independent cap-one marginals.
proof_constraint: A sharp proof cannot collapse grouped-coordinate product geometry to a single physical zero-pivot target triple while preserving concentration: the six-variable grouped witness exceeds 4.063, while the completed zero-pivot class is globally below 3.618 and no physical triple of the witness is target-scale.
